battle.name: 王德仁起義
battle.brief: 大業十年（614）十一月，隋煬帝第三次征高句麗無功班師之際，汲郡賊帥王德仁擁眾數萬，保林慮山為盜，依太行山東麓立寨。郡兵不多，中央精兵遠在涿郡與懷遠鎮一線，無力深入山區；起義軍以長兵、弓弩及簡陋器械據險待變，與同月離石劉苗王、東海彭孝才相互聲援，為隋末北方郡縣解體的徵候。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 交戰的一方是隋朝河南道汲郡的整套州縣軍事體系。汲郡治汲縣，地當太行山東麓，自開皇以來便是河北、山東通往洛陽的孔道，郡內設郡丞、郡尉與縣吏，領郡兵與縣鄉團練，另有隸屬郡府聽調的府兵殘部與臨時募來的鄉勇，供郵驛、烽燧、巡獵、捕賊等雜役。第二方是《資治通鑑》所記的「汲郡賊帥王德仁」所領的起義武裝：聚眾數萬，「保林慮山為盜」，在太行山東麓依山立寨，沒有國號、年號與常備編制，首領靠臨時推舉聚合，眾多為逃戶、亡命之徒與本地失業丁壯，器械與糧秣全靠自備與劫取。兩邊體量極不對稱：一方是有法有令、卻因精兵被抽調而空虛的郡縣機器；另一方是只在山裏才活得下去的臨時聯軍。同一個月內，離石胡劉苗王反自稱天子、眾至數萬，東海賊帥彭孝才轉掠沂水，說明起義已非孤立事件，而是跨郡同時燃起的地方叛亂。郡與郡不能相救，中央精兵遠在涿郡與懷遠鎮一線，地方只能靠郡兵獨撐。
countriesEn: One side was the entire prefectural military system of the Sui dynasty's Jing Commandery on the Henan circuit. The commandery was seated at Ji County, on the eastern foot of the Taihang Mountains, and had been a main corridor linking Hebei and Shandong to Luoyang ever since the Kaihuang era. Beneath the commandery administrator, the commandery judge and the county clerks sat the commandery levy and the county militia, together with the scattered remnants of the fubing and with villagers and townsmen hired for the season; these men carried the post service, manned the beacon towers, and performed patrols and the policing of bandits. The other side was the rebel armed force led by the man the Zizhi Tongjian calls the 'bandit chieftain of Jing, Wang Deren': several tens of thousands of men who 'took to the mountain of Linlü as brigands', establishing camps along the eastern slopes of the Taihang range. They had no state name, no era name and no standing establishment; the leader was chosen ad hoc, and the ranks were made up of registered households who had fled their taxes, men in flight and locally unemployed able-bodied workers, with weapons and grain either carried by the men themselves or taken by force. The two sides were badly mismatched. On one side stood a lawful administrative machine that had been hollowed out because its trained soldiers were away; on the other stood a temporary confederation that could only survive in the hills. In the same month the Hu chieftain Liu Miaowang rose at Lishi and proclaimed himself emperor with tens of thousands of men, and the eastern-sea bandit chieftain Peng Xiaocai moved along the Yi River, which shows that the rising was no isolated affair but a wave of local revolts lit across several commanderies at once. Commandery did not come to the aid of commandery: the court's best troops were far away at Zhuojun and Huaiyuan, and each locality could only hold on with its own levy.
people: 王德仁，汲郡人，《資治通鑑》卷一百八十二記作「汲郡賊帥王德仁」，大業十年十一月起事。史冊對他只有十幾個字的記載：「擁眾數萬，保林慮山為盜。」他如何聚眾、眾卒名籍、部下編制、所據山寨的方位以及最後下落，正史一字未載，這種空白本身就是隋末地方起義的常態。同期在北方各地的隋方人物則有名有姓：榆林太守成紀董純四月與彭城賊帥張大虎戰於昌慮，大破之，斬首萬餘級，十一月又討擒轉掠沂水的彭孝才，卻因有人譖其怯懦，被鎖詣東都處死；左驍衛大將軍屈突通五月受命為關內討捕大使，發兵擊延安賊帥劉迦論，斬迦論並將卒萬餘級，虜男女數萬口；將軍潘長文討離石胡劉苗王不克。朝廷一邊是皇帝楊廣：二月詔百僚議伐高麗，數日無人敢言，八月自懷遠鎮班師，十月「敕將帥嚴裝，更圖後舉」，十一月回到東都又殺朝臣斛斯政於金光門外，烹其肉使百官分食；太史令庚質以「比歲伐遼，民實勞弊」進諫，下質獄而死。
peopleEn: Wang Deren was a man of Jing Commandery. The Zizhi Tongjian, volume 182, records him as the 'bandit chieftain of Jing, Wang Deren', and dates his rising to the eleventh month of the Daye tenth year. The histories say almost nothing about him: a dozen words, that he 'gathered several tens of thousands of men and took to the mountain of Linlü as a brigand'. How he raised his men, what roll they kept, how the force was organised, where exactly his stronghold lay and what became of him are all unrecorded, and that silence is itself the normal condition of local uprisings under the late Sui. By contrast the Sui commanders of the same months are named: Dong Chun, commandery administrator of Yulin, defeated the Pengcheng chieftain Zhang Dahu at Changlu in the fourth month, killing more than ten thousand by the recorded count, and in the eleventh month captured the eastern-sea chieftain Peng Xiaocai as the latter moved along the Yi River; yet because someone accused him of cowardice, he was dragged in chains to the eastern capital and put to death. The Left Xiaowei Guard general Qutu Tong was appointed in the fifth month as commissioner for the suppression of rebels in the passes, marched against the Yan'an chieftain Liu Jialun and killed Liu together with more than ten thousand of his men, taking several tens of thousands of people captive. The general Pan Changwen could not break the Hu chieftain Liu Miaowang at Lishi. On the court's side stood the emperor Yang Guang himself: in the second month he called the ministers to deliberate on the campaign against Goguryeo and for several days no one dared speak; in the eighth month he withdrew from the fortress of Huaiyuan; in the tenth month he ordered the commanders to refit their arms and prepare for a further campaign; and in the eleventh month, back at the eastern capital, he killed the minister Hu Sizheng outside the Gate of Golden Light and had his flesh cooked and given to the assembled officials to eat. The Grand Astronomer Geng Zhi advised him that the years of war in Liaodong had exhausted the people; he was thrown into prison and died there.
kits: 這場戰爭裡沒有亞述長矛。卡面那件兵器是公元前九世紀亞述王國的短柄長刃鐵矛，矛頭下端帶套筒以插木杆，亞述步兵常把它與弓並用：左手持矛、右手張弓，射完即以矛接戰，單兵同時具備投射與刺擊兩種能力。它同 614 年汲郡山中的任何一支矛都不存在譜系或工藝上的連續——亞述的鐵鏃套筒是兩河流域城邦累千百年冶鑄的產物，隋代中原的長兵早已是本土鍛造的鐵矛頭或鐵鏨配木杆，而林慮山一帶的起義眾多數連像樣的矛頭都沒有，削尖的木杆纏上布條、綁上竹片即當作長兵使用。真正在汲郡山林中服役的，是三樣東西：郡兵的長柄槊與橫刀，弩（蹶張臂弩與床弩）及弓箭，以及守山用的木柵、拒馬、陷坑和簡陋的雲梯。亞述長矛放在這個位置，不是因為它形制相像，而是因為它代表的是一個已經解決的問題——如何讓同一名士兵在射擊與肉搏之間無縫切換；而在隋末的河南河北，兵員流失、兵源不繼，武器代際早已退居其次。運輸方面，山路崎嶇，全靠役夫擔運、牛車與運糧車隊，糧秣只夠支應短期屯守。
kitsEn: There is no Assyrian spear in this war. The weapon on the card is a short-hafted, long-bladed iron spear of the ninth-century BCE Assyrian kingdom, its head fitted with a socket for the wooden shaft; Assyrian infantry commonly used it together with the bow, holding the spear in the left hand and the bow in the right, shooting and then meeting the enemy on the point of the same weapon, so that a single man carried both missile and shock. It has no genealogical or craft continuity with any spear held in the hills of Jing in 614 CE: the socketed iron head of Assyria was the product of metallurgy accumulated over a thousand years in the city-states of the two rivers, and the long weapons of the Sui heartland had long since been locally forged iron heads or iron sockets on wooden shafts, while among the rebels of Linlü most had not even a proper head, a sharpened pole wound with cloth and bound with bamboo splinters being used as a long weapon. Three things actually served in the mountains of Jing: the commandery's long spears and sabres, crossbows (the shoulder-drawn stirrup bow and the bed crossbow) and bows, and the timber palisades, caltrops, pits and rough scaling ladders used to hold the hills. The Assyrian spear sits in this account not because the forms resemble one another but because it stands for a problem that had already been solved, namely how one man moves without a gap between shooting and close combat; in late Sui Henan and Hebei, with troops lost and replacements failing to arrive, the question of weapon generations had long since become secondary. On transport, the mountain tracks were rough and everything moved on the shoulders of corvée porters, ox carts and grain wagons, and the rations were enough for a short garrison and no more.
tactics: 起義方的戰術史冊只留下「保」與「為盜」兩個動作：數萬眾不據城、不攻城，退保林慮山這處山勢，以險阻、距離與改換駐地拖住官軍，待官軍疲師深入、糧道拉長再作打算；沒有常備編制意味著沒有正面會戰的樣板，隊伍靠首領聲望臨時聚合，作戰單位是數百人的小隊，游走於山谷、隘口與村落之間，遇官軍則散、官軍退則合。官軍這邊的做法，同一卷記載裡有可對照的樣板：董純以榆林太守之銜出戰昌慮，屈突通領關內討捕大使討劉迦論，都是集中一處先破其眾而後掃蕩餘部；而同年江都丞王世充討劉元進所部、宋顥討章丘杜伏威，則更能看出隋末野戰的常套路數——先以小股兵力接觸，陽為不勝，把敵眾引入葦叢，再從上風縱火，焚其營而潰之。火攻、夜襲、斷糧道、扼山口、設柵拒馬，構成本朝官軍對付山中流寇的標準動作；糧秣則自郡倉與東都方向西運，山道一日行程即損耗一程。指揮層同樣脆弱：董純屢勝卻被讒言鎖詣東都誅之，說明打勝仗的將領自身並不安全。
tacticsEn: For the rebels the records preserve only two verbs, 'to hold' and 'to be brigands'. Tens of thousands of men neither occupied a city nor attacked one; they withdrew to the heights of Linlü and used the terrain, the distance and shifting their quarters to hold the government troops at bay, waiting for the pursuers to tire deep in the mountains and for their supply line to stretch. With no standing establishment there was no standard for a pitched battle either: the force was a temporary aggregation held together by a leader's reputation, its tactical units bands of several hundred men moving among valleys, passes and villages, dispersing when the troops of the government appeared and closing up again when they withdrew. On the government side the same volume supplies usable parallels: Dong Chun marched out with the title of administrator of Yulin and fought at Changlu, Qutu Tong took the commission for suppressing rebels within the passes and struck at Liu Jialun, and both concentrated on breaking the main body first and mopping up the remnants afterwards. The clearest illustration of the late Sui pattern in the open field comes from the same year: the Jiangdu deputy Wang Shichong against Liu Yuanjin, and Song Hao against Du Fuwei of Zhangqiu. In both cases a small body made contact, deliberately lost ground, drew the enemy into the reed beds, and then fired from the windward side so that the camp burned and broke. Fire, night attack, cutting the supply line, holding the passes and staking out the approaches were the standard repertoire of the court against bandits in the hills; grain came from the commandery granaries and from the eastern capital, and every day of travel on the mountain roads consumed a day's worth of it. The command structure was equally fragile. Dong Chun won repeatedly, yet a single slander carried him in chains to the eastern capital to be executed, which shows that a general who won could not count on his own safety.
data: 可核對的數字幾乎全部出自《資治通鑑》卷一百八十二。王德仁「擁眾數萬」，是起義方唯一的兵眾數目；同月離石胡劉苗王「眾至數萬」，二月扶風賊帥唐弼立李弘芝為天子「有眾十萬」，五月延安賊帥劉迦論「有眾十萬」，與之形成對照的是隋方的斬首數：董純破張大虎「斬首萬餘級」，屈突通斬迦論「並將卒萬餘級」「虜男女數萬口」。兵役方面可見三處硬數與三處概括：二月「詔復徵天下兵，百道俱進」，三月「士卒在道，亡者相繼」，七月「時天下已亂，所徵兵多失期不至」；另有邯鄲賊帥楊公卿「帥其黨八千人抄駕後第八隊，得飛黃上廄馬四十二匹而去」。戶口方面，《隋書·食貨志》載大業年間全國戶增至八百九十萬上下、口約四千六百萬。本卡不列任何傷亡數字：通鑑對汲郡之役既無斬首記載，也無雙方死傷統計；林慮山的確切位置在傳世地理資料中亦無明文記載，故本卡取汲郡治汲縣一帶（今河南衛輝市西北，太行山東麓）的大概經緯度，誤差可能在數十里之內。
dataEn: Almost every verifiable figure comes from volume 182 of the Zizhi Tongjian. Wang Deren 'gathered several tens of thousands of men', the only strength figure recorded for the insurgents; in the same month the Hu chieftain Liu Miaowang at Lishi had 'tens of thousands of men'; in the second month the Fengyang chieftain Tang Bi set up Li Hongzhi as emperor with 'a host of one hundred thousand'; in the fifth month the Yan'an chieftain Liu Jialun likewise had 'a host of one hundred thousand'. Against these stand the government's kill counts: Dong Chun defeated Zhang Dahu with 'more than ten thousand heads taken', and Qutu Tong killed Liu Jialun 'together with more than ten thousand of his men' and took 'several tens of thousands of men and women captive'. Three hard facts and three general statements mark the conscription of troops: in the second month 'the edict was issued to levy the soldiers of the empire again, all by a hundred routes'; in the third month 'the soldiers perished on the road one after another'; and in the seventh month 'the empire was already in disorder and many of the men summoned failed to arrive at the appointed time'. There is also the case of the Handan chieftain Yang Gongqing, who 'led eight thousand of his party to raid the eighth echelon behind the imperial carriages and carried off forty-two flying-yellow horses from the imperial stables'. On population, the Treatise on Revenue and Stores of the Book of Sui records that by the years of Daye the households of the empire had grown to about 8,900,000 and the mouths to about 46,000,000. This card lists no casualty figures at all: the Tongjian records neither a count of the slain nor any estimate of losses on either side for the fighting at Jing, and the exact location of the mountain of Linlü is nowhere stated in the surviving geographical material. The coordinates used here therefore give the approximate position of the commandery seat at Ji County, to the north-west of present-day Weihui in Henan on the eastern foot of the Taihang range, and the error may amount to some tens of li.
cause: 起義的成因不能脫開大業十年的整體崩解。第一是兵役：二月「詔復徵天下兵，百道俱進」，三月御駕幸涿郡時「士卒在道，亡者相繼」，至臨渝宮以斬叛軍者祭鼓而「亡者亦不止」，七月「所徵兵多失期不至」，八月班師後十月又「敕將帥嚴裝，更圖後舉」——戰爭只是暫停，徵發並未停止，汲郡這樣的孔道州郡年年被抽丁、徵車、運糧。第二是「盜」的法律：通鑑記「是歲，詔為盜者籍沒其家。時群盜所在皆滿，群縣官因之各專威福，生殺任情矣」，郡縣為討盜而獲得生殺之權，程序與界線都被攻破，底層民眾在「流民」與「盜」之間被逼到無路可退。第三是治理真空：府兵久已歸農，中央精兵遠在遼東與涿郡，鄰郡各守其土，郡兵既少又疲。第四是朝廷的反應方式：十一月殺斛斯政、烹其肉使百官分食，庚質進諫下獄而死，地方由此看穿王朝拒絕止戰的意圖。第五是榜樣效應：同年唐弼奉李弘芝為天子、劉迦論建元大世、劉苗王自稱天子，敢另立旗號者已在三處出現；王德仁不敢稱帝、只求保山，正是因為他仍在求活而未求天下。
causeEn: The origins of this rising cannot be separated from the general collapse of the Daye tenth year. First, conscription: in the second month 'the edict was issued to levy the soldiers of the empire again, all by a hundred routes'; when the emperor reached Zhuojun in the third month 'the soldiers perished on the road one after another'; at the palace of Linyu he had the rebels beheaded to beat the drum for the sacrifice, and 'even there those who perished did not stop'; in the seventh month 'the empire was already in disorder and many of the men summoned failed to arrive at the appointed time'; and after the withdrawal in the eighth month, in the tenth month the court ordered 'the commanders to refit their arms and prepare for a further campaign'. The war was only suspended, not ended, and the levies went on, so that a corridor commandery such as Jing was drained of men, carts and grain year after year. Second, the law against bandits: the Tongjian records for that year 'the edict was issued that the families of bandits were to be confiscated. Bandits were then to be found everywhere, and the county officials of every district, taking advantage of this, each exercised unchecked authority, killing and sparing as they pleased'. Granting the counties power of life and death in the name of suppressing bandits destroyed procedure and limits alike, and the people at the bottom were driven into a corner with no exit between the vagrant and the brigand. Third, the vacuum of government: the fubing had long since returned to the fields, the court's trained troops were far away in Liaodong and at Zhuojun, each commandery watched only its own ground, and the local levy was both too small and too tired. Fourth, the court's own way of answering: in the eleventh month the killing of Hu Sizheng and the cooking of his flesh for the officials to eat, and the imprisonment of Geng Zhi until he died in his cell, told the provinces that the dynasty refused to end the war. Fifth, the effect of example: in the same year Tang Bi set up Li Hongzhi as emperor, Liu Jialun proclaimed the era Daye, and Liu Miaowang styled himself emperor; men ready to raise a new banner had appeared in three places. Wang Deren did not proclaim an emperor and asked only to hold his mountain, precisely because he was still seeking to live rather than seeking to rule the realm.
impact: 這場起義的意義不在戰果，而在它所處的結構。汲郡一郡之內出現數萬眾的武裝集團，而郡兵無力深入，這說明隋朝到 614 年只剩下「縣以下尚可徵集、上級已無兵可用」的狀態。十一月同一個月裡有離石劉苗王、東海彭孝才、汲郡王德仁三處起事，分布於河東、河北、河南三個方向，這已經不是流寇式的零星騷動，而是跨郡同步的網狀局面——通鑑所謂「群盜所在皆滿」的正是這種局面。平叛機制同樣腐壞：董純四月破張大虎、十一月擒彭孝才，戰功累累，卻因一句讒言被鎖詣東都誅之，將領打勝仗反而要付性命代價，郡以下的武人於是不肯盡力，這正是大業十一年之後北方叛勢愈演愈烈的前提之一。兵源也從此大幅轉移：郡兵、逃戶、役夫與民間渠帥所聚的人馬，大批流向他處的割據軍隊，隋亡之後成為瓦崗李密與竇建德部下的重要兵源。史書不載王德仁一支的下場，這種空白本身即說明地方起義在正史中的處境；而林慮山這類據點長期存在，也預示了河北道、並州道山地聚落武裝化的傾向，貞觀年間的河北叛亂仍重複同樣的地形邏輯。
impactEn: The significance of this rising lies not in its military result but in the structure it belongs to. Inside a single commandery several tens of thousands of men formed an armed band, and the commandery levy could not penetrate the mountains to deal with them; this shows that by 614 the Sui dynasty retained nothing beyond the ability of a county to muster men, while above the county there were no troops left to use. Three risings in the single month of the eleventh - Liu Miaowang at Lishi, Peng Xiaocai in the eastern sea commandery, and Wang Deren at Jing - lay in three different directions, across Hedong, Hebei and Henan. That was no longer the scattered turbulence of roving bands but a mesh-like pattern synchronised across commanderies, and it is this that the Tongjian means when it says that bandits were to be found everywhere. The mechanism for putting the rising down was equally rotten. Dong Chun broke Zhang Dahu in the fourth month and captured Peng Xiaocai in the eleventh; his record was full of victories, yet a single slander had him dragged in chains to the eastern capital and killed, so that a general who won risked his life for it. Martial men below the commandery level consequently had little reason to give their best, and that is one of the preconditions for the northern rebellion worsening after the Daye eleventh year. The flow of men also shifted dramatically from that point on: levy troops, tax absentees, corvée porters and the companies gathered by village chieftains moved in large numbers into the armies of the regional contenders, and after the fall of the Sui they became an important source of soldiers for Li Mi at Wagang and for Dou Jiande. The histories do not record what became of Wang Deren's band, and that blank itself describes the position of local risings in the official narrative. The persistence of strongholds such as Linlü also foreshadowed the arming of mountain settlements in the Hebei and Bingzhou circuits, a pattern of terrain that the Hebei rebellions of the Zhenguan era would repeat.
result: 就傳世記載看，這場起義在大業十年十一月並未被平定。通鑑只有「汲郡賊帥王德仁擁眾數萬，保林慮山為盜」一句，既沒有記官軍攻破林慮山，也沒有記王德仁降或死；同月見於記載的平叛結果都發生在別的戰線：董純討擒彭孝才（而董純旋遭誅殺），潘長文討劉苗王不克。同一個月裡，離石胡劉苗王自稱天子、眾至數萬而官軍不能克，說明北方已出現官軍無力收拾的成片武裝。大業十一年之後，局面更壞：二月上谷人王須拔反、自稱漫天王、國號燕，魏刁兒自稱歷山飛，兩部眾各十餘萬；三月煬帝再幸涿郡，於雁門被突厥大軍圍困，詔天下諸郡募兵，等到次年隋室已在各地被劉武周、竇建德、瓦崗等勢力分割，汲郡與林慮山一線的武裝也隨之併入群雄割據，此名從此消失於正史。可以確定的結果只有兩條：起義方短期內沒有被消滅，長期佔據太行山東麓；官方則在折損將領、疲耗郡兵的代價下維持了局部的表面秩序，而這層秩序在三年之內便全面崩解。
resultEn: According to the surviving records, this rising was not put down in the eleventh month of the Daye tenth year. The Tongjian has only the one sentence, that the 'bandit chieftain of Jing, Wang Deren, gathered several tens of thousands of men and took to the mountain of Linlü as a brigand'; it records neither the storming of the mountain by government troops nor the surrender or death of Wang Deren. The suppressions recorded in that same month all belong to other fronts: Dong Chun captured Peng Xiaocai, and Dong Chun himself was then executed; Pan Changwen could not break Liu Miaowang. That in the very same month the Hu chieftain Liu Miaowang proclaimed himself emperor with tens of thousands of men and the government could not take him shows that large bodies of armed men had by then arisen in the north beyond the reach of the troops sent against them. The situation grew worse after the Daye eleventh year: in the second month a man of Shanggu, Wang Xuba, rose and styled himself the King of Man with the state name of Yan, and Wei Diao'er proclaimed himself the Flying One of Mount Li, each with more than one hundred thousand men; in the third month the emperor travelled once more to Zhuojun and was besieged at Yanmen by a great Turkic army, and an edict called on all commanderies to raise troops. By the following year the Sui house was being carved up by the rival powers of Liu Wuzhou, Dou Jiande and the Wagang forces, and the armed bands on the Jing and Linlü line were drawn into that partition of the realm, after which the name disappears from the official histories. Only two results can be stated with certainty: the insurgents were not destroyed in the short term and continued to hold the eastern foot of the Taihang range for a long while; and the authorities maintained a surface order in the area at the cost of executed commanders and an exhausted levy, and that order collapsed completely within three years.
